correctness.rationale: I independently enumerated all C(12,4)=495 masks; exactly 61 independent quartets. Enumerating every nonempty 12-vertex subset gives 1415 K and 2679 T simplices and the exact f-vectors in RESULT. Rebuilt deterministic row-major vertex-toggle matchings: K 697 pairs, residual critical 1 vertex and 20 5-cells; T 1329 pairs, 1 vertex and 20 4-cells. Independently built entire directed Hasse graphs, respectively 6160 and 13744 cover incidences; topological sorts visited all nodes with no gradient cycles. Forman therefore proves integral wedges, stronger than Betti numbers alone. Signed reduced Lefschetz trace enumeration for 1,R,C,RC yields (20,0,-4,0) on both; the independent 20 square-triples permutation has character (20,0,4,0) and column sign twist gives same rational character. Modules over Q[V4] are determined by characters. Standalone verify_grid_robust.py was inspected and independently reproduced in separate local script; exhaustive finite enumeration is a genuine finite proof here, not sampling or assertion from a log.
